jobs.description:
**Full-time | Remote | Onboarding**

### **About the Role**

Anchor Utility Company is looking for a Client Onboarding Specialist to help multifamily clients launch services such as Resident Billing, Utility Expense Management, and Vacant Cost Recovery. You’ll guide assigned properties from kickoff through setup in our billing platform, First Time Billing, client approval, and handoff to Operations.

You’ll be a primary point of contact for clients during onboarding. This role is a good fit if you enjoy working with clients, keeping several projects moving at once, and catching details that could affect a resident’s first bill.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Set expectations at kickoff, request required information, and keep clients informed about progress, next steps, and delays.
* Manage multiple property implementations at once. Track milestones and deadlines, follow up on open items, and escalate issues that could delay launch or first billing.
* Configure properties in our billing platform using client requirements, utility billing methods, supporting documentation, and applicable billing guidelines.
* Coordinate First Time Billing, review results for accuracy, work with internal teams to resolve discrepancies, and obtain client approval.
* Hand off each property to Operations with approved billing, complete documentation, and a clear record of any open items.
* Partner with Client Engagement, Operations, Accounting, Meter Solutions, and other teams to resolve issues, document processes, and improve how we onboard properties.

### **What You’ll Bring**

**Required**

* Prior experience in utility billing, property management, multifamily housing, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain billing or setup steps clearly to clients and internal teams.
* Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several projects and deadlines at once.
* Proactive follow-through and accountability for assigned work.
* Sound problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently, including knowing when to escalate an issue.
* Comfort learning new software, systems, and processes.

**Preferred**

* Direct experience with resident utility billing or utility expense management.
* Familiarity with ratio utility billing systems (RUBS), submetering, direct-billed utilities, or utility billing regulations.
* Experience with property management platforms such as Yardi, Entrata, or AppFolio.
* Experience in client onboarding, implementation, or account management.
* Experience reviewing utility invoices, billing reports, or financial documentation.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Competitive pay and a benefits package.
* A collaborative team that works across departments to help clients launch services successfully.
* Opportunities to develop your skills in client implementation, multifamily utility billing, and project coordination.

### **How to Apply**

Apply through Anchor Utility Company’s online employment application. We look forward to learning about your experience and how you’ve helped clients or properties through a successful transition.

**Anchor Utility is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**

jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
The Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator partners with the Experience Manager to attract, hire, onboard, and develop the people who make Effortless Office special. This role supports the full hiring lifecycle, from interviewing candidates and completing background and reference checks to preparing and sending offer letters, and makes sure every new hire has a smooth, welcoming start. They coordinate onboarding and new hire training, track and process 45-day and 90-day performance reviews, and manage the annual company review cycle from kickoff through completion. With a strong eye for detail and a commitment to confidentiality, the Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator creates a consistent, effortless experience for every candidate and employee, from the first interview through every review.  
  
**Location:** 100% Remote  
**Reports To:** Experience Manager  
**Schedule:** Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm PST  
**Compensation:** $55,000 – $60,000 annually  
**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Formal and structured mentorship
* Training and certification support

  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Recruiting & Interviewing**

* Partner with the Experience Manager and hiring managers to understand staffing needs and post open positions on job boards and other recruiting channels.
* Screen resumes and applications and conduct initial screening interviews via Microsoft Teams to identify qualified candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews, participate in interviews, and gather feedback from hiring teams.
* Communicate promptly and professionally with candidates throughout the hiring process and keep candidate records accurate and up to date.

**Background Checks, References & Offers**

* Initiate and track background checks, ensuring each is completed and cleared before a new hire’s start date.
* Conduct professional reference checks and summarize findings for the Experience Manager and hiring manager.
* Prepare and send offer letters, track acceptances, and confirm start dates with new hires and their managers.
* Handle all candidate and employee information with strict confidentiality and in line with company policy and employment regulations.

**Onboarding & New Hire Training**

* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, ensuring new hire paperwork and PEO enrollment are completed accurately and on time.
* Work with hiring managers, IT, and Accounting so new hires have the equipment, system access, and information they need on day one.
* Schedule and facilitate new hire orientation and training on company policies, core values, and our EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) practices.
* Track completion of required new hire training, including security awareness training.
* Serve as a go-to resource for new hires during their first weeks with the company.

**Performance Reviews**

* Schedule, track, and process 45-day and 90-day performance reviews for all new hires, ensuring they are completed on time.
* Prepare review materials for managers and follow up on outstanding or overdue reviews.
* Manage the annual company review cycle, including timelines, communications, manager reminders, and completion tracking.
* Maintain accurate review documentation and report on completion status and trends to the Experience Manager.

**Employee Experience & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential employee and hiring records.
* Develop and refine templates, checklists, and processes to create a consistent experience for candidates, new hires, and managers.
* Support the Experience Manager with employee engagement initiatives and other HR projects as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
* Preferred Certifications: aPHR, PHR, or SHRM-CP
* 3+ years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, onboarding, or HR coordination.
* Experience conducting interviews, background checks, and reference checks.
* Working knowledge of employment practices related to hiring, background screening, and recordkeeping (e.g., EEO, FCRA, Form I-9).
* Experience with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HRIS, or PEO platforms preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel.
* Experience in an IT, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or technology services environment is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple candidates and deadlines at once.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a warm, professional approach with candidates and employees.

**Why Join EO?**  
At EO, our employees are what makes us special. We are a highly collaborative company with a very involved senior leadership team that invests in their staff. We strive to be a company where every employee has a voice, everyone takes pride in their work and gets satisfaction from helping people, and where every employee is constantly learning and driving improvements.  
  
We are aligned through our core values and seek employees that embody these:

* Service – we are dedicated to providing EFFORTLESS support and solutions. We ensure client and end user satisfaction in every interaction.
* CWC – this stands for Communicate, Work, Communicate, because communication is twice as important as the work we do.
* Perspective – we embrace the customer’s viewpoint to inspire confidence and meet expectations.
* Efficiency – we maximize output and minimize wasted time, effort, and resources.
* Passion – we bring energy and enthusiasm to everything we do and are driven by a commitment to excellence.
* Reliability – we consistently deliver on promises, follow through on commitments, and are dependable in all situations.
* Merit – we recognize and reward talent, hard work, and the pursuit of excellence.

**Inclusion & Equal Opportunity Employment**  
Effortless Office is an equal opportunity employer committed to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Existing relationships in the regulatory community are valuable. Equally important is the ability to earn trust, understand a workflow, and move a project from an initial conversation to successful adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Qualified agency relationships with clearly understood needs.
* Pilot opportunities with an internal sponsor and a realistic approval path.
* Well-scoped deployments that staff can use effectively.
* Measurable improvements in case organization and administrative workflows.
* Strong ongoing relationships that support renewals, expansion, and referrals.

**Why BoardWise**

Regulatory processes affect professional livelihoods, public protection, and trust in institutions. The people administering those processes need practical tools that help them manage demanding work.

At BoardWise, you’ll help shape an emerging part of our business, work closely with the founders, and influence products built around real agency needs.

Please submit your résumé and a short note describing your experience with licensing boards, regulatory agencies, government technology, or public-sector implementations. Include an example of a partnership or project you helped move from an initial conversation to adoption, if applicable.

Please do not include confidential information from current or former employers or clients.

**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Consultant - Assets & Inventory**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Manager, Implementation Consulting  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $80,000

### **Job Summary:**

First Due is seeking a tech-savvy, customer-focused fire and EMS subject matter expert to work as an Implementation Consultant – Assets & Inventory. In this role, you will work with Fire & EMS customers to implement and optimize First Due's Assets & Inventory module, providing industry-leading guidance and support as First Due continues to build its best-of-breed end-to-end Fire and EMS platform.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on fire or EMS operational experience, a deep understanding of apparatus and equipment lifecycle management, medication and controlled substance accountability, and the ability to translate complex agency workflows into scalable software configurations.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Act as the subject matter expert and Implementation Consultant for the Assets & Inventory module.
* Work directly with new customers to efficiently and effectively configure and optimize the Assets & Inventory module, including apparatus tracking, equipment inventory, inspection workflows, and maintenance scheduling.
* Partner with Implementation Project Managers to successfully implement and launch First Due to Fire and EMS agencies of varying sizes and complexities.
* Guide customers on best practices for apparatus and equipment lifecycle management, including compliance with NFPA 1911, NFPA 1912, NFPA 1852, and other applicable standards.
* Advise agencies on structuring inventory hierarchies, asset categorization, and inspection frequency aligned with their SOGs and regulatory requirements.
* Guide ALS agencies on configuring medication and controlled substance inventory tracking, including DEA compliance workflows, expiration date management, chain-of-custody documentation, and par-level replenishment for Paramedic and Advanced EMT units.
* Provide configuration guidance on maintenance tracking, out-of-service workflows, and integration with other First Due modules including Scheduling, Incident Reporting, and Response.
* Stay educated on module functionality, configuration options, and evolving industry best practices and compliance requirements specific to fire apparatus, EMS equipment, and medication management.
* Maintain a full understanding of features in current and future sprints as well as the Assets & Inventory product roadmap.
* Document product gaps identified during implementation and collaborate with Product Management to ideate solutions, particularly around compliance and operational workflow requirements.
* Participate in regional and national user group meetings, both virtually and in person, representing the Assets & Inventory product area.
* Develop a deep understanding of competitors' capabilities within the asset management and inventory space for public safety.

* This is a remote role, but the employee must live in the US.

* Familiarity with NFPA standards governing apparatus inspection, testing, and maintenance (NFPA 1911, 1912, 1852, etc.).
* Understanding of common fire and EMS inventory workflows including daily/weekly checks, SCBA management, and PPE lifecycle compliance.
* Familiarity with ALS medication management practices, including controlled substance accountability, DEA recordkeeping requirements, and EMS formulary tracking as they relate to inventory systems.
* Experience with public safety software platforms or operational technology (asset management, fleet management, or similar systems) is a plus.
* Ability to take customer requests, determine the desired end state, and provide a clear, efficient path to the best solution.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with attention to detail.

**Position Highlights:**

**You Belong at Avera**

**Be part of a multidisciplinary team built with compassion and the goal of Moving Health Forward for you and our patients. Work where you matter.**

 **A Brief Overview**  
  
The EHR Application Principal Trainer - Pharmacist is an Information Technology role responsible for designing, developing, validating, maintaining, and delivering role-based application training for assigned electronic health record (EHR) and healthcare information system applications. This role partners with informatics analysts, operational leaders, subject matter experts, and the system-wide learning team as appropriate to ensure training curriculum, workflow scenarios, course assignments, and training environments accurately reflect approved system configuration, role-based access, operational workflows, and release changes for all phases of medication management and closed-loop processes. The position serves as the application training and curriculum subject matter expert, supporting safe, efficient, standardized, and optimized use of the electronic health record and related healthcare applications. This role does not own system level learning strategy, leadership development, general employee development, onboarding, compliance education, or non-EHR education programs.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Develop and maintain application curriculum: • Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve role-based application training curriculum, lesson plans, workflow scenarios, tip sheets, job aids, exercises, eLearning content, and supporting materials for assigned EHR and healthcare information system applications, addressing all phases of medication management and closed-loop medication processes.
* Support application change control and release readiness : • Participate in application workgroups, change control discussions, upgrade planning, release reviews, testing activities, and optimization initiatives to identify training impacts and update curriculum prior to implementation.
* Analyze roles and training assignments: • Analyze end-user roles, application access, workflows, and training requirements to maintain application-specific course catalogs and support appropriate training assignments.
* Coordinate curriculum review and approval: • Facilitate curriculum review with subject matter experts, informatics application teams, and operational stakeholders to confirm workflow accuracy and obtain required approvals before implementation.
* Build, test, and maintain training environments.: • Build, validate, test, maintain, and troubleshoot training environments, training patients, exercises, and scenario data in partnership with informatics analysts and environment support teams.
* Deliver application training: • Deliver instructor-led, virtual, recorded, and targeted one-on-one application training for end users, super users, application training partners, and internal staff for assigned EHR and healthcare information systems applications.
* Evaluate training effectiveness: • Review learner feedback, assessment results, help desk trends, workflow issues, and stakeholder input to identify training gaps and implement continuous improvements to curriculum, materials, and delivery methods.
* Serve as the application training subject matter expert: • Provide application-specific guidance, workflow reinforcement, refresher training, and post-training support to learners, super users, application training partners, and stakeholders. • Escalate application build, configuration, access, or workflow issues to the appropriate IT teams.
* Prepare training delivery readiness: • Prepare training materials, training records, classroom or virtual delivery tools, and required technology to support effective learning experiences. • Partner with system-wide learning resources when system-level learning platforms, templates, or reporting are required.
* Manage training deliverables and documentation: • Manage multiple curriculum development, upgrade, optimization, and training readiness deliverables while meeting established timelines. • Maintain curriculum trackers, training environment checklists, course documentation, and related artifacts in accordance with IT, application vendor, and Avera standards.

The individual must be able to work the hours specified.
